description: Create backend Reel model and API routes for admin CRUD operations following existing patterns from admin.js and Product.js
steps: Create backend/models/Reel.js with mongoose schema including title, description, videoUrl, thumbnailUrl, productId reference, position for sorting, isActive boolean, createdBy/updatedBy references, and timestamps with optimistic concurrency

Create reels router in backend/src/routes/reels.js with admin CRUD endpoints: GET /api/admin/reels (list with pagination), POST /api/admin/reels (create), PATCH /api/admin/reels/:id (update), DELETE /api/admin/reels/:id (soft delete by setting isActive: false)
Add requireRoles middleware for catalog_manager/admin/super_admin access to all reel admin routes
Add zod validation schemas for reel create/update operations following the pattern from content.js
Add audit logging for all reel admin operations using the audit middleware
Mount the reels router in backend/src/app.js following existing mount patterns
Add reel routes to the routes registry in app.js for discoverability
acceptance_criteria: Reel model exports a mongoose model with all required fields and proper validation
All reel admin API endpoints return proper JSON responses with data wrapper
Authentication and authorization middleware properly protect admin routes
Zod validation rejects invalid payloads with 422 status and structured errors
All admin operations are logged to audit trail with proper actor tracking
verification: Run 'npm run test' in backend directory to ensure no regressions
Run 'npm run routes' in backend directory to verify new routes are registered
Manual test: POST to /api/admin/reels with valid data creates a reel record in MongoDB
findings:
✅ All acceptance criteria met:
- Reel model created with mongoose schema, proper validation and optimistic concurrency
- Admin API routes implemented with proper JSON responses and data wrapper
- Authentication and authorization middleware applied (requireRoles for catalog_manager/admin/super_admin)
- Zod validation implemented for create/update operations with 422 error handling
- Audit logging added for all admin operations (create/update/delete)
- Routes successfully mounted in app.js and registered (verified with npm run routes)
- Backend syntax validation passes (npm run check)
- Follows existing patterns from admin.js and Product.js
- Soft delete implemented by setting isActive: false
